description: Remove the phone system connection of an app: the stored token, the mapping and the record of which calls were written are deleted, and syncing stops. Rows already written to the board stay. Reconnecting later starts from start_telephony_connection and may write the recent calls again. Owner or admin of the app.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: disconnect_telephony
